accuracyFlags: 'Operators run rail carts ... including through the Hobbits Hole tunnel' - Hobbit's Hole is the road tunnel (Moki Tunnel) on SH43, not on the Stratford-Okahukura railway used by the rail carts; looks conflated. Verify with Forgotten World Adventures and fix.
'Egmont National Park' - the park was renamed Te Papakura o Taranaki under the Taranaki Maunga settlement; verify and use the current name.
'Republic Day celebration runs biennially' - verify the next date (odd-numbered years, January) and date it for 2027.
Road status / fuel claims (no fuel along SH43, unsealed Tangarakau Gorge section) have no NZTA/DOC source link.
